text_block_list.text:
The day of Biwa Hayahide's debut race has 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's only the Make Debut, this is 
still a gathering of promising girls who 
each earned a contract with a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In addition, this is a long-awaited chance 
for practical application. Let us steel 
ourselves and face the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I promise to bring back results 
worthy of those cheers.
